data.content_ref: inline:The isolated node shares mechanism with SRC_004: both invoke source independence and operational independence as distinct dimensions of verification. The isolated node's question (whether single-engine verification can be independent) operationalizes SRC_004's two-dimensional audit protocol. REFUTED IF: source and operational independence are shown to be perfectly correlated in practice (e.g., same training history always produces identical run records, or vice versa), collapsing the two dimensions into one and eliminating the shared mechanism.
